setup.description: Configure verification and post the panel

options.channel: Channel where the verification panel is posted
options.unverified_role: Role given on join and removed once verified
options.attempts: Wrong answers allowed before a 5 minute lock

panel.title: Verification
panel.description: To access the server, click the button below and type the code shown. This protects us from bots and raids.

modal.title: Verification
modal.label: Type this code: {code}
modal.placeholder: Upper or lower case, with or without spaces

verify.title: Verification
verify.disabled: Verification is disabled on this server.
verify.noRole: The verification role no longer exists. Please tell an administrator.
verify.locked: Too many mistakes. Try again in {time}.
verify.expired: This code has expired. Click the button again to get a new one.
verify.wrong: Wrong code. Click the button again for a new code ({left} attempt(s) left).
verify.grantFailed: Correct code, but I could not give you the role. Please tell an administrator (permissions or position of the bot's role).
verify.success: Welcome to **{server}**! You now have access to the server.

kick.dm: You were kicked from **{server}** because you did not verify within {time} of joining. You can come back with an invite and click the verification button.

logs.locked: {user} entered a wrong code too many times and is locked for 5 minutes.

errors.title: Not possible
errors.badDuration: Invalid duration. Use for example `10m`, `2h` or `1d` (between {min} and {max}), or `0` to never kick.

role.managed: {role} is managed by an integration and cannot be given.
role.hierarchy: {role} is above my highest role: move my role higher in the server settings.
role.noPermission: I am missing the "Manage Roles" permission.

errors.sameRole: The verified role and the unverified role must be different.
errors.missingPerms: I am missing these permissions in {channel}: {perms}.
errors.panelFailed: The panel could not be posted. Check that the channel exists and that I can write and embed links there.
errors.notEnabled: Verification is not enabled. Use `/verification setup` first.

setup.title: Verification enabled
setup.noKickPerm: Warning: I am missing the "Kick Members" permission, unverified members will not be kicked.
setup.channelTip: Tip: remove "View Channels" from @everyone on your channels and grant it to {role}, keeping {channel} visible to everyone. Members already here are not affected.

disable.title: Verification disabled
disable.done: Verification is disabled and the panel deleted. {count} scheduled kick(s) cancelled.

main.title: Verification
main.description: New members click a button and type a code to get access. After changing the channel or the text, post the panel again.

help.role: Given after passing the captcha. It must be below the bot's role.
help.unverifiedRole: Optional: given on join, removed after verification.
help.channel: Channel visible to everyone that holds the button.
help.kickAfter: 0: never. Otherwise between 1 minute and 7 days.
help.maxAttempts: After this many mistakes the member is locked for 5 minutes.
